name: scientific-meeting-prep
description: Creates evidence-grounded technical customer meeting briefs from calendar, email, public science, and official product sources, with clear workflow maps and seller-ready questions.

interface.longDescription: Find the right customer meeting, recover the relevant email thread, research the science and official product fit, and create a seller-ready Markdown brief with workflow diagrams, technical questions, source links, and clearly labeled gaps.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a technical brief for my next customer meeting.
Find my upcoming scientific meeting and research the email context.
Turn this meeting invitation into a Markdown scientific meeting brief.
